about_the_game:
A space game can never have too many spaceships. That's why I'm bringing you the SHIPYARDS DLC, with unlimited ships to explore the infinite universe!

Design Your Own Custom Starting Ships

Use a point-based system to choose your starting ship's stats. Then assign weapons, devices, and away team gear from everything in the game!

Upgrade the Custom Shipyard

Make more powerful ships! Tow 5-deck shipwrecks to stations in exchange for "Shipyard Tokens" which can be spent to increase the number of points you have to design starting ships.

Share Your Shipyard Designs

When you hit save on one of your designs, an alpha-numeric code is created that you can share with other players. Then on the "load build" screen, there is an option to "load from code". Copy and paste in a code and the build will appear!

I've created a channel in our discord for sharing these, and there will be a central Steam thread as well. (Unfortunately I can't link them directly here.)

More Ships For Sale

Space station shipyards will now have 4 choices available, including several based on the new system. And station shipyards will never sell out. You'll be practically swimming in spaceships! (Just remember to wear your suit...)

Meet the Shipwright

Starting ships don't last forever. Try getting to sector 1000 with that little asteroid miner you started with. You're in luck because there's a new salesperson at your local asteroid base: The Shipwright!

They can scan your ship and build a better one. Just expect to pay a hefty fee, and not just credits either. They need materials: crafting parts, essences, gadgets, and more.

New Ship Art

34 new ship images to choose from, including these:

Unleash your creativity and build the ship of your dreams today with

Approaching Infinity: Shipyards DLC!
